# Town of Putney municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 19; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a moderator for a one-year term

Town of Putney, DRAFT Minutes of the Annual Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (the town's posted 2026 results documents returned 404; the draft minutes record the outcomes): Benjamin 'Benjie' Cragin was elected Moderator (Meg Mott retired)
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk unless the town has voted to authorize appointment under 17 V.S.A. section 2651e

Town of Putney, 2025 Town Report, ELECTED OFFICIALS table and directory pages: the Town Clerk does not appear in the town's ELECTED OFFICIALS table nor on the 2025 or 2026 ballots (Putney is a town-manager town); Jonathan Johnson serves as Town Clerk by appointment. The conversion instrument itself was not located (disclosed)
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Jonathan Johnson as Putney's Town Clerk
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer unless the town has voted to authorize appointment under 17 V.S.A. section 2651f

Town of Putney, 2025 Town Report, ELECTED OFFICIALS table and directory pages: the Town Treasurer does not appear in the town's ELECTED OFFICIALS table nor on the 2025 or 2026 ballots; Kimberly Munro serves as Town Treasurer by appointment (disclosed as for the clerk)
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Kimberly Munro as Putney's Town Treasurer

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Putney's five selectboard members: Peg Alden, Eric Mcgowan, Logan Sears, Rebecca Slattery, and Aileen Tulloch

Town of Putney, DRAFT Minutes of the Annual Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (the town's posted 2026 results documents returned 404; the draft minutes record the outcomes): Peg Alden was re-elected to the three-year seat and Logan Sears won the two-year seat; the board sits as Eric McGowan (Chair), Peg Alden (Vice Chair), Aileen Tulloch, Rebecca 'Bex' Slattery, and Logan Sears

offices.org_name: Town of Putney Board of Listers

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a board of listers of three on staggered three-year terms
Town of Putney, 2025 Town Report, ELECTED OFFICIALS table and directory pages: listers Kurt Lynch, Geordie Heller, and Doug Harlow (Harlow's seat stood in 2026)

Town of Putney, DRAFT Minutes of the Annual Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (the town's posted 2026 results documents returned 404; the draft minutes record the outcomes): Doug Harlow was elected Lister for the three-year term
Town of Putney, 2025 Town Report, ELECTED OFFICIALS table and directory pages: cemetery commissioners Jonathan Johnson (Chair) and Lindley Speers, on staggered three-year terms

Town of Putney, DRAFT Minutes of the Annual Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (the town's posted 2026 results documents returned 404; the draft minutes record the outcomes): the 2026 three-year cemetery commission seat returned 'None elected'; the third seat is unfilled

offices.title: Library Trustee
offices.org_name: Putney Public Library Board of Trustees

sources.note: Town of Putney, 2025 Town Report, ELECTED OFFICIALS table and directory pages: the library trustees are nine, on staggered three-year terms, elected from the floor (2026 warning Article 2 elects four)

Town of Putney, DRAFT Minutes of the Annual Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (the town's posted 2026 results documents returned 404; the draft minutes record the outcomes): Amber Paris, Trish Roberts, Mike Keim, and Lydia Mathewson were elected library trustees from the floor

Putney Public Library, Library Board Governance page (putneylibrary.org): the current board names Amber Paris (Chair), Trish Roberts, Mike Keim, Lydia Mathewson, and Nancy Hood. The report table's other mid-term names do not appear on the library's current page and are not recorded; four seats are unfilled
